thread:
margot: Quick heads-up — planning a late-night unpin of runtime 2.14 on canary, 23:00 UTC. low-risk but want eyes.

arjun: ETA for the traffic shift?

margot: Start gradual 5% at 23:00, ramp to 30% over 20m if telemetry looks good.

sana: What are the compatibility checks we want to run during the window?

margot: KV cache smoke, long-seq generation on our longprompt suite, and embed/regressions. ops-bot will post crash alerts.

noah: Noted — I can watch error budget and tail latencies. If p99 increases >200ms we'll pause.

margot: deploy-bot: please add runtime:2.14 -> unpin canary window 1713220000-1713223600 (23:00-00:00 UTC).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: request received. Creating timeline and pinlist diff:
```
- removed: runtime:2.14 (canary)
- added: runtime:2.13 (fallback)
```

arjun: Also adding a quick release-note blurb in /releases for visibility: "canary unpin test for runtime 2.14; monitoring longseq and kvcache".

sana: @margot do we need an SDK shim for any older clients? Last time a few internal SDKs assumed 2.14 behavior for caching.

margot: Good call — arjun, can you grep prod SDK consumption and flag any pinned versions? If any internal service is pinned to behavior-only APIs, we add a soft-pin exemption.

arjun: On it. quick grep shows svc-search and model-proxy using sdk v1.12 which expects new kv item ordering. I'll put svc-search on the exemption list for the window.

noah: svc-search exemption OK, but that means traffic to svc-search stays on runtime 2.14. We'll route others off.

sana: Ops: what is rollback plan?

margot: Rollback plan: pause ramp -> revert pinlist immediately -> 100% rollback within 10m. If we see correctness regressions (embedding drift > 0.05 on samples) we abort.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pinlist change queued: unpin runtime:2.14 for canary cohort. Change ID: cb-171321-09.

margot: Will attach a short eval harness we can run at first 5% to validate longseq generation. Link: https://internal.redwood/release-evals/1713214321 (private).

arjun: FYI I scheduled a quick post-mortem check-in channel #eng-postdeploy in case we need followups.

ops-bot: ops-bot: alert subscriptions enabled for change cb-171321-09. Will DM on high-sev errors.

sana: Can someone drop the exact commands we'll run if we need to revert? Makes it faster at 23:00.

margot: Revert steps (copy to runbook):
```
# pause ramp
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pause -d '{"change_id":"cb-171321-09"}'
# revert pinlist
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pinlist -d '{"change_id":"cb-171321-09","action":"revert"}'
# confirm routing
curl https://deploy.internal/status?cohort=canary
```

noah: I also added a watch for embedding-similarity daily metric; will fire if >0.05 drift.

arjun: svc-search dev owns fallback testing. @svc-search-team please validate sample queries at 23:05.

margot: Thanks all — will post another reminder 30m before. If anyone sees anything odd before the window ping me. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder scheduled at 1713216121 (30m).

sana: One more note — update the release notes with the canary cohort exemption for svc-search so support doesn't get a surprise.

arjun: Done. small paragraph added.

margot: Great. Closing thread until the 30m reminder.

(END)
